response.sql: WITH id_counts AS (SELECT ID, COUNT(*) as record_count, COUNT(*) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination) as share FROM Examination GROUP BY ID), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share_value FROM id_counts), above_avg AS (SELECT id_counts.record_count, id_counts.share, (id_counts.share - avg_share.avg_share_value) as beat FROM id_counts CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE id_counts.share > avg_share.avg_share_value) SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_record_count, AVG(share) as avg_share, AVG(beat) as avg_beat FROM above_avg

assumptions.assumption: Share is computed as (record count for that ID) / (total record count across all Examination records), not normalized by patient count or any other dimension
